package: Goal In One: First Ten Levels, v0.1 (design intent)
status: Unimplemented schematic design; positions, par and force parameters must be tuned against actual game physics

coordinate_system.boundary: Solid 2-unit border on all sides; floor at y=4

integration_notes: Treat these as designer-authored specifications, NOT validated finished gameplay.
Inspect actual project physics, velocity limits, current objects and level data before implementation.
Keep unlimited mid-flight kicks and instant restart; do not add cooldowns or shot locks.
Forward pad means boost toward right, backward pad boost toward left, loss pad immediate reset, unless the project has different semantics - adapt while keeping player-facing intent.
All geometry must fit within boundaries and should not obstruct touch UI.
Goals may face left or right; test outer goal contacts cannot trigger completion.
Tune par scores after recording practical solutions; no artificial limits on completion.
An engine level editor and data-driven authoring are preferred over hardcoded per-level geometry.
A reviewer must actually finish every level before declaring it complete.
Animations, sound, particles should not delay user inputs.

levels.name: First Touch
levels.role: Introduce the goal and satisfying one-kick success
levels.intended: A single clean, obvious shot reaches the goal. The first successful kick should feel immediate.
levels.teaching: Show a temporary drag-to-aim illustration only if needed; hide it after the first successful shot.
levels.quality_gate: First-time player understands controls without a text wall.

levels.name: The Loft
levels.role: First satisfying obstacle, not a difficulty spike
levels.intended: One well-aimed high arc clears the central wall. Additional kicks remain legal.
levels.teaching: Obstacle visibly blocks the straight shot while leaving a generous opening above.
levels.quality_gate: A one-shot solution must be achievable without pixel-perfect aiming.

levels.name: High Ground
levels.role: Teach elevation and landing on platforms
levels.intended: Use a rising sequence of platforms or an impressive single long arc; reaching the raised goal is the puzzle.
levels.teaching: Visually distinct shelf immediately below the goal.
levels.quality_gate: No ball-trapping corners; two-kick path should be forgiving.

levels.name: Fast Lane
levels.role: Introduce green forward boost through a low open corridor
levels.intended: Roll or kick onto the green pad to accelerate under an overhead canopy, then direct the ball into the goal.
levels.teaching: Green arrow and a short one-time pad pulse make direction unmistakable.
levels.quality_gate: The boost must be noticeable but not so powerful it causes unavoidable ricochets.

levels.name: Counterflow
levels.role: Introduce reverse pad with a change of direction
levels.intended: Player starts on the right and travels left through the underpass; the orange reverse pad helps push the ball toward the left goal.
levels.teaching: One intentionally reversed level establishes what backward means.
levels.quality_gate: Left-facing goal should register entries correctly. No ambiguity over the pad direction.

levels.name: Red Alert
levels.role: Introduce loss pads as an avoidable, readable hazard
levels.intended: Cross the red floor strip with a lofted shot, optionally bouncing from raised safe islands.
levels.teaching: Red region is visible well before the first shot; touching it resets immediately.
levels.quality_gate: No unavoidable deaths due to spawn placement; retry is instantaneous.

levels.name: The Window
levels.role: First timing challenge, with safe clear space
levels.intended: Observe the gate movement, then kick when the low corridor is open or arc above it.
levels.teaching: Obstacle motion is periodic and visibly telegraphed before input.
levels.quality_gate: Gate timing is fair; one near-miss should encourage a retry, not frustration.

levels.name: Boost and Brake
levels.role: Combine two learned pads without introducing new hazards
levels.intended: Accelerate early, then solve the elevated approach while accounting for a reverse pad on the transfer shelf.
levels.teaching: Two differently coloured pad types are visible simultaneously.
levels.quality_gate: There must be multiple possible recoveries; reverse-pad contact cannot softlock the ball.

levels.name: Red Light, Green Light
levels.role: Combine timing, boost and loss risk
levels.new_mechanic: Moving sweeper plus forward boost plus red zone
levels.intended: Use a boost, time movement past the sweeper, and clear the red section to finish.
levels.teaching: Player can see both timing and danger zones from the start.
levels.quality_gate: No blind hazard, impossible deadline or mandatory rapid-fire input.

levels.name: The Final Trick
levels.role: End chapter with a memorable, flexible multi-mechanic level
levels.intended: Reach the lower platform, clear a timed gate and a red reset zone, then climb to the elevated goal. Strong players optimise kick count.
levels.teaching: All elements are familiar; the challenge is their combination.
levels.quality_gate: 3-star route must be demonstrated via playtest; an alternative multi-kick route must remain accessible.
